description: cargo-mutants survivors on fabric-core and fabric-app that are equivalent to the original code, named with their position, with the argument. `cargo xtask cargo-mutants` fails on any other missed mutant and on an entry that no longer survives (for example because the code moved). Timeouts count as detected. Adding an entry is a trust-boundary change.

equivalent.reason: The comparison is reached only after the branch for sequence == last, so sequence < last and sequence <= last agree on every reachable input.

With equal times the interval is 0 s, so the rate is x/0: infinite, or NaN when the values are equal. The finiteness check added for CX-RATE-NON-FINITE turns every such pair into a reset, exactly as the strict comparison does.
